sql: select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."id" = ? and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1

select "roles".*, "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "role_has_permissions"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id" from "roles" inner join "role_has_permissions" on "roles"."id" = "role_has_permissions"."role_id" where "role_has_permissions"."permission_id" in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)

select "permissions".*, "model_has_permissions"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" as "pivot_permission_id", "model_has_permissions"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type" from "permissions" inner join "model_has_permissions" on "permissions"."id" = "model_has_permissions"."permission_id" where "model_has_permissions"."model_id" in (1) and "model_has_permissions"."model_type" = ?

select "roles".*, "model_has_roles"."model_id" as "pivot_model_id", "model_has_roles"."role_id" as "pivot_role_id", "model_has_roles"."model_type" as "pivot_model_type" from "roles" inner join "model_has_roles" on "roles"."id" = "model_has_roles"."role_id" where "model_has_roles"."model_id" in (1) and "model_has_roles"."model_type" = ?
select * from "masjids" where "masjids"."id" = ? and "masjids"."deleted_at" is null limit 1
select * from "school_years" where "masjid_id" = ? and "school_years"."masjid_id" = ? order by "first_day" asc
select * from "school_closures" where "school_closures"."school_year_id" in (1) and "school_closures"."masjid_id" = ? order by "closed_on" asc

select * from "group_memberships" where "role" in (?, ?) and exists (select * from "groups" where "group_memberships"."group_id" = "groups"."id" and "kind" in (?, ?) and "groups"."deleted_at" is null and "groups"."masjid_id" = ?) and "group_memberships"."id" = ? and "group_memberships"."masjid_id" = ? limit 1

select "id", "first_name", "last_name", "avatar_character", "avatar_tone", "avatar_color", "staff_avatar_character", "staff_avatar_tone", "staff_avatar_color" from "contacts" where "contacts"."id" in (1) and "contacts"."deleted_at" is null and "contacts"."masjid_id" = ?
select "id", "name" from "groups" where "groups"."id" in (1) and "groups"."deleted_at" is null and "groups"."masjid_id" = ?
select distinct "group_id", "session_date" from "attendance_records" where "group_id" in (?) and "session_date" >= ? and "session_date" < ? and "attendance_records"."masjid_id" = ?
